before: The recomposition native no-op shortcut compared committed payload attributes while application proposals were pending. Returning a proposed attribute to its committed value could leave its pending group unchanged.
after: Pending application proposals disable the canonical no-op shortcut. Exact working-target equality still avoids redundant writes. Restoring the committed value uses the existing owned inverse transaction and preserves undo/redo.
reason: Only private admission logic changes. Existing native operations and proposal records remain authoritative. No shared field, schema, provider, public API, or package version changes.
